NUCCESS Recommendation Rules Engine v5.0: v5.0 replaces v4.1. It adds 20 emotions with a slider, a full body & senses list with urgent signs, task chips (NUCRIPCE in plain words), no-task suggestions, Dump routes, Move and Dance, Create, first-run settings, return to work/study/training tools and what each plan can select. Founder decisions of 11 November 2026.

column2: FigCit App — Developer Brief (November 2026) and NUCCESS Ordered Activity Tables v4.0. All three use the same rule and pattern IDs.

Capacity (Tab 1) sets the starting colour → feelings with their slider (Tab 2) and body signs (Tab 3) can lower it ONE step in total (FE-1, FE-2, BS-1, CAP-1) → place, 'Can you step away?' and devices (Tabs 4–5) never change the colour; they choose the route and tools (CX-R, DV-R) → the card follows a pattern (Tab 11) with approved words (Tab 17) → tasks are sorted by chip (Tab 10); with no task, a task that fits is suggested (TK-4).

Pick up to TWO emotions from 20, each with a slider. The slider is the only control shown; the backend turns it into Mild, Moderate, Strong or Very strong. The stronger emotion decides (FE-3). Free shows 10 + 'Something else (type it)'.

Urgent body signs (slurred speech, breathless, chest pain, suddenly can't move part of the body, sudden change in sight) always ask 'Is this sudden or new for you?' (SF-4). Help/SOS is on every screen. Clinical sign-off needed before launch.

Tab 18: every colour and route outcome — 5 starting colours × (20 emotions + Something else) × 4 strengths × 6 body classes, plus 'no emotion' (2,550 rows). Tab 19: route by place for every emotion (20 × 8 places × 2 colours = 320 rows). Tab 20: 201 realistic stories with the full card.

Max two emotions; slider only. Context and devices decide the route, never the colour. Feelings, intensity and body lower the colour by one step at most. Create sits under Regulate; Write under Express. Dance is part of Regulate → Move and helps wind down for sleep. Users play their own music or royalty-free tracks. Settings before the first check-in. Free has limited choices; Prime and Premium unlock the full lists (Tab 9).

No browse mode; four sign-up fields; prices before VAT; Prime £7/£70, Premium £13/£130, organisation seat £10/£100 = Premium; Life right now with a fixed Help line; no peer community; messages are sent from the phone.
Clinical review of SF-1 to SF-4 and the urgent screen; physiotherapist or dance movement psychotherapist review of guided movement (MV-6); Help/SOS numbers.
